info.title: wieDoetHet API
info.description: Backend API for the wieDoetHet task-assignment platform. Authentication is handled inside each Lambda function via Bearer JWT. Anonymous users (share-link access) do not need a token.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format without leading + (e.g. 31612345678)

tasks.description: Tasks to include in the poll. Max 10 (3 or fewer sends buttons, 4-10 sends a list).

title.description: Truncated to 20 chars for button messages, 24 chars for list messages.

description.description: Shown as row description in list messages. Truncated to 72 chars.

WhatsAppWebhookEvent.title: WhatsAppWebhookEvent

wa_id.description: Sender phone number in E.164 format without +

name.description: WhatsApp display name — stored as anonymousName on the claim.

from.description: Sender phone number — used as sessionId for deduplication.

WhatsAppWebhookEvent.description: Incoming webhook payload from Meta for POST /webhook/whatsapp. Only interactive message replies (button_reply / list_reply) result in a claim being created.

UpdateProfileInput.title: UpdateProfileInput

phoneNumber.description: WhatsApp-capable phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +31612345678). Must start with + followed by 8–15 digits. Send null to remove the stored number.

UpdateProfileInput.description: Request body for PATCH /auth/profile. Allows a registered user to update their WhatsApp phone number. All fields are optional — omit a field to leave it unchanged; send null to clear it.
